_comment: 35-40 s Hybrid Pilot, beat format: the director (tools/lib/director.mjs) turns narration beats + intents into shots, transitions, speed/hold and camera. Timing is provisional until narration.srt / narration.whisper exists; then the measured timing drives every cut. Sound files that are missing are skipped and reported. No music.
